title: PH60411: Quantum Information Theory
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Probabilities and laws of large numbers, General introduction; Quantum
operations, Quantum error correction, Classical information and Shannon
entropy, Linear algebra and axioms of quantum mechanics, Qubits, Quantum
states: (Mixed states, Multiple systems and entanglement), Qubit operations,
Quantum algorithm, Quantum cryptography, Quantum dynamics and measurements,
Quantum circuit model, Quantum circuit model, Cloning and distinguishability,
Quantum entropy, Bipartite pure-state entanglement, Mixed-state entanglement
and entanglement monotones.Prerequisites: Classical Mechanics I, Quantum
Mechanics I and II, Mathematical methods II.
